lightningOps.autofeeMovementSettingsSubtitle: Tune how fast fees can adapt and fall.
lightningOps.autofeeMovementSettingsHint: Use 0 or empty to keep profile defaults.
lightningOps.autofeeMovementHintCooldownUp: Minimum wait before another upward fee move. Higher = slower raises; lower = faster reactions.
lightningOps.autofeeMovementHintCooldownDown: Minimum wait before another downward fee move. Higher = slower drops; lower = faster fee reductions.
lightningOps.autofeeMovementHintStepCap: Maximum fee change per round. Higher = more movement per run; lower = smoother adjustments.
lightningOps.autofeeMovementHintDiscoveryDownCap: Extra down-step cap used in discovery-like situations. Higher = faster unlock/down moves.
lightningOps.autofeeMovementHintStallRelaxGap: Minimum gap between current fee and target before stall-relax softens the floor. Lower = relaxes earlier; higher = protects floors longer.
lightningOps.autofeeMovementHintInboundDiscountMaxRat: Maximum inbound discount as a share of the applied outbound fee. Higher = more aggressive inbound pricing.
lightningOps.autofeeMovementHintLowFlowFloor: Floor multiplier when outbound flow is low. Higher = keeps fees higher; lower = allows lower floors.
lightningOps.autofeeMovementHintGlobalLockMinOut: Minimum out ratio to soften global negative-margin lock. Lower = lock softens for more channels.
lightningOps.autofeeMovementHintGlobalLockMaxDrop: Lowest allowed drop toward peg when global lock is softened. Lower = permits deeper cuts.
lightningOps.autofeeMovementHintHtlcMinAttempts: Minimum HTLC attempts needed to classify a channel. Lower = more HTLC-driven reactions.
lightningOps.autofeeMovementHintHtlcPolicyFailRate: Policy-failure rate threshold for HTLC signals. Lower = easier to trigger policy-hot behavior.
lightningOps.autofeeMovementHintHtlcLiquidityFailRate: Liquidity-failure rate threshold for HTLC signals. Lower = easier to trigger liquidity-hot behavior.
lightningOps.autofeeSoftenMinOutRatioOverride: Global lock soften min out ratio (%)

settingsHints.autoEnabled: Turns on periodic scans and automatic rebalances.
settingsHints.scanInterval: How often the auto engine scans channels for opportunities.
settingsHints.dailyBudgetPct: Daily spend cap as a % of the last 24h routing revenue.
settingsHints.deadband: Minimum outbound deficit before a channel becomes a target.
settingsHints.sourceMinLocal: Minimum local liquidity (outbound %) required for a channel to act as source.
settingsHints.econRatio: Fraction of outbound fee used as max fee for route finding.
settingsHints.econRatioMaxPpm: Caps the max fee ppm when using econ ratio (0 = no cap).
settingsHints.feeLimitPpm: Overrides econ ratio with a fixed max fee ppm (0 = disabled).
settingsHints.lostProfit: Subtract estimated source channel fees from the max fee budget.
settingsHints.roiMin: Minimum expected ROI (7d revenue / estimated cost) to auto rebalance.
settingsHints.maxAmount: Maximum sats per rebalance attempt. 0 = no cap.
settingsHints.minSplitEnabled: When enabled, probe minimum and execution minimum are configured independently.
settingsHints.minProbeAmount: Lowest amount used by route probing while searching for capacity.
settingsHints.minExecuteAmount: Minimum amount allowed to settle a rebalance attempt when split mode is enabled.
settingsHints.mppEnabled: Prepares multi-source parallel settings. Legacy flow remains active until MSPR rollout is enabled.
settingsHints.mppAutoOnly: When enabled, MSPR is used only for auto jobs and manual runs stay on legacy mode.
settingsHints.mppMaxShards: Maximum number of shards per round. Higher values can improve success but increase route pressure.
settingsHints.mppParallelism: How many shard attempts can run at the same time.
settingsHints.mppMinShardSat: Minimum shard size used by MSPR when splitting amounts.
settingsHints.mppRoundTimeout: Timeout per MSPR round before falling back to legacy attempts.
settingsHints.feeSteps: Number of fee limits tried from low to high.
settingsHints.amountProbeSteps: Number of amount probes from large to small per fee step.
settingsHints.failTolerancePpm: Stop probing when amounts differ by this ppm.
settingsHints.attemptTimeout: Maximum time per attempt before moving to the next fee/amount.
settingsHints.amountProbeAdaptive: Caps next attempts based on the last successful amount.
settingsHints.rebalanceTimeout: Maximum runtime per rebalance job (auto or manual).
settingsHints.manualRestartWatch: When manual auto-restart is enabled on a channel, keep monitoring and restart if it falls below target after success.
settingsHints.mcHalfLife: Decay time for mission control failures. Lower values forget failures faster. 0 = leave LND default.
settingsHints.paybackMode: Unlock when routing revenue pays back the rebalance cost.
settingsHints.timeMode: Unlock after N days since last rebalance.
settingsHints.criticalMode: Allow partial release when sources are scarce.
settingsHints.unlockDays: Days before protected liquidity can be reused.
settingsHints.criticalRelease: Percent of protected liquidity released per critical cycle.
settingsHints.criticalMinSources: Minimum eligible sources required to avoid critical mode.
settingsHints.criticalMinAvailable: Minimum total source liquidity required to avoid critical mode.
settingsHints.criticalCycles: Number of consecutive critical scans before releasing.
